(u3, else) -> u3

(u0, switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1

(u1, switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1
(u2, at_exit, u3) -> 1.0
feedback: Accepted. Format: all headers present and well-formed; FINAL_STATES is nonempty (u3), u3 is declared in STATES, and it is accepting only via task-satisfying terminal transitions. Semantics match the stated task (if the siren ever rings, at least one flip anywhere in the run, before or after the ring): u0->u2 covers a flip before any ring, u0->u1->u2 covers ring-then-flip, and u0->(at_exit & !siren_ringing)->u3 covers trivial satisfaction when the siren never rings. u2->u3 on at_exit deliberately ignores the siren state, which is correct for 'at least once, before or after' (a still-ringing or re-started siren at exit still passes, and no regression on re-rings is required). The violation case (ring occurred, no flip ever, exit while ringing) is unambiguously routed by (siren_ringing & !switch_toggled) to u1 and stuck there with no reward. Same-step co-occurrences are handled: in u0 the label {siren_ringing, switch_toggled} matches only the switch_toggled guard and correctly moves to u2 (obligation discharged), and {at_exit, siren_ringing} matches only the ring guard and moves to u1; at_exit cannot co-occur with switch_toggled or box_fell per the environment constraints, so the guards within each state are mutually exclusive and the else clauses are unambiguous. Irrelevant propositions (holding_box, box_fell) and all remaining labels are absorbed by per-state else self-loops in all four states. Rewards: a single bounded 0.1 progress bonus on the required flip transition (awarded at most once; toggles in u2 and every self-loop pay 0, so no farming), and 1.0 terminal on both accepting exit transitions; total is bounded by 1.1, and the exit reward is only paid on reaching u3, so a satisfied-but-never-exiting episode earns no terminal reward. Minor non-blocking notes: the u0 flip bonus also pays in siren-free runs where no flip is needed (bounded and harmless; restricting the bonus to u1->u2 would align it more tightly with the conditional obligation), and the !siren_ringing conjunct in (u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) is redundant since any ring leaves u0 immediately, but it is harmless defensive wording. The 4-state machine is minimal for this task.
